attempts.summary: Created an LVM logical volume (vg_data/lv_data) backed by two loopback-file physical volumes on node1 (disk was fully partitioned with no free space), mounted it at /srv/data, wrote test data, then grew it live from 1.1G to 2.14G by adding a second PV and extending the LV/xfs filesystem while mounted — data verified intact throughout. Persisted the setup via a systemd oneshot service (lvm-loop-setup.service) ordered before local-fs-pre.target plus an fstab entry with x-systemd.requires, then restarted node1 with systemctl reboot, confirmed a changed boot_id, and verified the LV auto-reactivated, remounted, sized correctly, and both test files passed sha256 verification post-restart.
